message: As a grandparent, I often find myself in the delightful chaos of family gatherings, where the little ones are always on the move! It can be easy to forget that emergencies can happen even in our busy lives. I recently came across a great resource that helps us think about what should go into a preparedness kit. It’s a gentle reminder that being ready can bring a little peace of mind, even amidst the laughter and giggles. What little things do you keep on hand for those unexpected moments?
